 SUBSTITUTION published at 87 mins 87 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Fulham make their final changes of the match.
 Gonzalo Garcia and Timothy Castagne are replaced by Rodrigo Muniz and Hugo Larsson.
 60 34 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:47 GMT 31 October 21:47 GMT 31 October 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Villa behind Bournemouth, Brighton and Brentford as it stands. Tell me again why Unai Emery is the best manager in the league?
 Jake, Manchester 
 377 1412 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:46 GMT 31 October 21:46 GMT 31 October 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 You just feel like in these last five or 10 minutes it's all here for the taking.
 131 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 83 mins 83 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Aston Villa win a corner with seven minutes plus added time to go.
 It comes to Matty Cash and he sends the ball into a busy penalty area. It's flicked on by Pau Torres but drops wide.
 68 30 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 79 mins 79 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Fulham changes incoming.
 Josh King and Oscar Bobb are replaced by Kenny Tete and Cesar Palacios.
 For the hosts, Ross Barkley is on for Boubacar Kamara.
 102 43 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 78 mins 78 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Woah, that's a naughty one as well.
 Tom Cairney shoves Ibrahim Mbaye then drags him back when he realises he won't win the foot race and he goes into the book for that.
 Image source, PA Media 
 116 44 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 YELLOW CARD published at 77 mins 77 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 That's a painful one from Matty Cash on the top of Josh King's foot and he goes into the book for it.
 That's his fifth yellow card of the season so that will be a one-match suspension for the Villa full-back.
 132 173 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'The belief wasn't there from Iwobi' published at 21:37 GMT 31 October 21:37 GMT 31 October 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 He should have hit it first time, I just think the chance was there with his left foot.
 The belief wasn't there from Iwobi.
 70 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 75 mins 75 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Alex Iwobi runs onto the ball and should maybe take the shot on but he takes a touch and that allows Matty Cash to step in and block his shot.
 They win a corner, though.
 Tom Cairney replaces Iwobi just before the set piece is taken.
 55 37 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 72 mins 72 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 If Fulham can find a winner here they would go level on points with Aston Villa.
 That's how tight things are in the table at the moment.
 142 137 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 21:31 GMT 31 October 21:31 GMT 31 October 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Suzuki is world class yeah? Villa look a poor side here, they’re going to tumble down the table with this thin squad when the European competitions really get going.
 Jon, Eastleigh 
 339 1685 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 A triple change for Aston Villa.
 Off: Johan Manzambi, Alysson and Leon Goretzka
 On: Ibrahium Mbaye, Emi Buendia and Joao Gomes
 229 32 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Heart sinks' for Suzuki published at 21:29 GMT 31 October 21:29 GMT 31 October 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 Your heart sinks for Zion Suzuki. We have all been there, but it's moments like that you need to forget and move on.
 345 90 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 68 mins 68 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 There might have been an element of luck for Fulham with that goal but they have deserved an equaliser for this second-half showing.
 221 114 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's a gift' published at 21:28 GMT 31 October 21:28 GMT 31 October 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 It's a gift.
 It's a simple catch under the crossbar. 
 Suzuki's under pressure, but not a lot, rather than catching, he should punch, but he decides he needs to catch. It's too late
 It's a horrible moment, in what has been a great performance from the Aston Villa goalkeeper.
 225 127 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 67 mins 67 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham 
 The VAR had a look at that but I have no idea why.
 The goal line technology is on the referee's watch? Not sure why VAR needed to check but here we are It's definitely a goal.
 197 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Aston Villa 1-1 Fulham published at 21:26 GMT 31 October 21:26 GMT 31 October 
 Zion Suzuki (own goal, 65 mins) 
 Oh no!
 Fulham win a corner and the delivery from Alex Iwobi is right on top of goalkeeper Zion Suzuki. He fumbles the catch and his momentum takes him over his goal line.
 It is a horrible moment after he has been so brilliant so far in this game.
 Image source, Getty Images 
 964 1126 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21:25 GMT 31 October 21:25 GMT 31 October 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Rob Green 
Former Premier League goalkeeper on Sky Sport 
 No one in a white shirt can believe it.
 What a save, and an even better block.
 105 16 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 CLOSE! published at 63 mins 63 mins 
 Aston Villa 1-0 Fulham 
 Goodness me how have Fulham not scored.
 Alex Iwobi is denied by Zion Suzuki at close range before Gonzalo Garcia sees his effort blocked. Last-ditch defending.
